## Findings
- [ ] **[WARN][Milestone] Open milestone `v0.9.0` was not closed after the v0.9.0 release**
  - **Status quo:** milestone #9 `v0.9.0` open, 14 closed issues, 0 open issues.
  - **Likely cause:** milestone closeout is part of the release step (07) and was skipped; the v0.9.0 release notes were created without it.
  - **Proposed solution:** 07-gh-release auto-closes it during the v0.9.1 release (open_issues == 0, closed_issues > 0 → qualifies under the legacy close rule).
  - **Handoff:** handled by `/07-gh-release` "Auto-close milestones"; no separate issue needed.
- [ ] **[WARN][Docs] No CHANGELOG.md file in the repo**
  - **Status quo:** changelog content lives in GitHub release notes + `docs/migrations.md` (per-minor-release entries).
  - **Likely cause:** intentional convention documented in CONTRIBUTING.md §Releasing ("Create the release with notes derived from the merged PRs").
  - **Proposed solution:** keep the convention; patch releases get no migrations.md entry (documented as "one minor release at a time").
  - **Handoff:** none — release notes prepared in this report (below).
